summary: Internal analytical-release audit of March 2025, signed by Clara Fenwick. It checks compound-card traceability against the delivery records, records two transcription findings that were corrected before release, and gives the closure evidence for the purity reconciliation of the delivery lots.

title_block.title: Internal analytical release audit
title_block.subtitle: Compound-card traceability and delivery-lot purity reconciliation
lines: Prepared by Clara Fenwick, Analytical Release Lead

blocks.p: This audit checks the analytical release records for the most recent delivery lots. It covers compound-card traceability, the transcription of purity results onto the compound cards, and the reconciliation of purity between the release records and the delivery paperwork.
The audit was run as an internal check. It does not replace the client's own acceptance testing.

list: Every compound card in the release set was traced back to its delivery lot and isolated-material record
Purity values on each card were compared with the release HPLC report by area percent at the stated wavelength
The delivery paperwork was compared with the lot list held by the sample desk

list.text: Cards with no release report on file were held back and not counted as passed

blocks.p: The audit team did not change any analytical data. Corrections were made to the compound cards only, and each correction is listed in section 3.

rows: Purity value on one card did not match the release HPLC report. The value had been copied from the draft, not the final report.
Value replaced from the final release report; card re-issued
Wavelength on one card was recorded as the default, not the wavelength used for the release run.
Wavelength corrected on the card; release report unchanged
Lot list and delivery note disagreed on the lot label for one delivery.
Lot list was right; delivery note corrected
table.caption: Table 1 Audit findings and corrections

blocks.p: Findings 1 and 2 were both transcription errors on the compound cards. Neither changed a release decision, because the release reports had already been checked before the cards were written.

The purity reconciliation was closed for every delivery lot in the release set. Each lot's purity on the compound cards now matches the release HPLC report, and the delivery paperwork carries the same lot label as the lot list.

list: Compound cards re-checked against the release reports after the corrections
Delivery notes re-checked against the lot list
Release reports filed with the delivery lot records

blocks.p: No delivery lot was released on the basis of an unchecked purity value.
The release records for the audited delivery lots are traceable. The three findings have been closed with the corrections listed above, and no release decision has been changed.
The audit will be repeated at the next quarter's release review. Compound-card transcription is to be checked against the final release report, not the draft.
